item.title: Students show off geography knowledge at annual Geography Bee
item.description: CAMDEN — Students from across Preble County gathered Thursday, Feb. 19, at Preble Shawnee for the 2026 Preble County Geography Bee, an academic competition designed to challenge elementary and middle school students on their knowledge of geography, world locations and landmarks.
